---
name: Ranking proposal
about: Propose a new TopTenUG metric, index, or trend leaderboard
title: "[Ranking] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Ranking name

Proposed public name:

## Ranking type

- [ ] METRIC — directly observable measurement
- [ ] INDEX — TopTenUG composite algorithm
- [ ] TREND — growth, velocity, or movement ranking

## Why should this ranking exist?

Describe the user value and why it belongs in TopTenUG.

## Universe / category

Where should it live in the TopTenUG taxonomy?

## Eligible entities

Define exactly who/what can be ranked and the required Uganda relationship.

## Candidate discovery

How will TopTenUG find eligible candidates without relying only on already-famous entities?

## Data sources

List the authoritative and supporting public sources.

## Raw metrics

List the inputs before normalization or weighting.

## Normalization

Explain how metrics with different scales will be made comparable.

## Formula / weights

For INDEX rankings, provide the proposed formula and weights. For METRIC/TREND rankings, define the calculation precisely.

## Freshness / time window

Define recency, time decay, growth window, and quarter behavior.

## Missing data

How should unavailable metrics be handled?

## Anomalies / manipulation

How should suspicious spikes, spam, bot-like growth, duplicate identities, or data errors be treated?

## Tie-breaking

Define deterministic tie-breaking rules.

## Explainability

What should a user see when they click "Why this rank?"

## Validation

How can we test whether the ranking behaves sensibly and fairly across the candidate universe?

## Known limitations / bias

State likely blind spots explicitly.

## Example

Provide a small worked example if useful. Do not manually nominate a winner as a substitute for the methodology.
